name: v2-cartesian-linear
covers: SmoothieV2 Prime Cartesian linear motion, reversal and return to origin
review: At 80 steps/mm the X/Y moves require 80/40, 80/40 and 160/80 steps, with the last move reversed; both motors return to zero. Each short diagonal is sqrt(1.25) mm. At 10 mm/s and 100 mm/s^2, the continuous acceleration/cruise profile from 0 to 10 mm/s (or the reverse) takes 0.161803 s; the recorded 0.16180 s and 0.16125 s differ by at most 0.35%. The return is sqrt(5) mm with a zero-to-zero profile of 0.323607 s versus 0.32282 s recorded (0.25% difference). Adjacent block starts overlap by one 10 us tick as recorded. This approximation does not independently verify the discrete stepping algorithm or physical timing; two simulator runs produced identical JSON.
